messages:
emily: Holding merge on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8192 — gating on architecture eyes. RFC linked below. Main risk is shard-affinity change interacting with autoscaler and KV cache eviction; could bump p95. Can arch please take a quick look?

emily: RFC: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-shard-affinity-and-autoscaler.md

carlos: :eyes: pinging arch. Quick Q — can you add the SLO delta numbers to the PR description? and confirm whether this needs a rollout gate or is ok behind a canary. Also include what `autoscaler.max_replicas` / `min_replicas` you tested with.

emily: added numbers in the PR body: baseline p95=85ms, expected p95≈115ms at steady QPS=1k (perf run). Memory pressure on shard nodes +8% in that run. Canary plan proposed: 10% traffic for 2h then 50% for 1h if no regressions. Rollback: automatic traffic shift to routing-v1 variant.

sasha: do we have a perf harness repro? If not i'll run one tomorrow with `--affinity=shards-v2` and `--qps=1000` to get KV eviction traces. That will show if tail latencies spike due to cache churn.

raj: oncall note — if p95 > 150ms during canary, ops should flip routing to fallback route and page oncall. Can we add that threshold to the canary playbook? cc @sre

carlos: thanks. arch: besides numbers, need a decision on whether this is an allowed infra change without RFC follow-up. If arch wants, we can gate merge until explicit "arch-ack" in thread. I'm fine to do code review once arch confirms.

arch-bot: Automated arch checklist reminder:
- SLO delta present
- Canary plan attached
- Rollback plan present
- Security/privacy: no customer data changes
Please respond with arch-ack or concerns.

emily: done — added canary metrics (error budget burn, p95 median), rollout steps, and the rollback trigger. Will wait for Carlos + arch-ack. thanks! :pray:

sasha: :thumbsup: i'll run the harness first thing and paste results here.

carlos: +1. arch: please reply in-thread with `arch-ack` when you're good so we can merge after the canary window.

emily: tagging the PR again w/ summary so it surfaces in review queues.
_meta: This thread is a short engineering coordination convo about gating a PR on architecture review and an RFC. Messages are in chronological order and formatted as Slack-style chat lines.
